body_html:
Standing out isn’t about gimmicks. It’s about making your best work impossible to miss in a 15-second skim.

The default path (Drive folders, Canva PDFs, unfinished Notion pages) makes you look busy — not hire-ready.

This guide is for students in active placement or internship season who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

undefined

Do this next

  1. URL on resume header and LinkedIn Featured
  2. One hero project with outcome metrics
  3. Working contact method (email or Hire Me CTA)

Translate campus work

Replace “CSE Mini Project” with the problem you solved, who it helped, and what changed. Faculty titles impress faculty. Outcomes impress employers.

Time-boxed shipping

Set a timer. Publish with three projects and a clear bio. Perfection is a moving target; a live URL is a fixed asset you can improve.

How a website helps you stand out

When dozens of CVs arrive the same morning, a calm live site is the signal that you finished something and can share it cleanly.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • URL on resume header and LinkedIn Featured
  • One hero project with outcome metrics
  • Working contact method (email or Hire Me CTA)

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
